title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Correction Fee on Types That Take the Originals Back
content:
This page governs the correction fee that Aurelia Hanse Line books when an issued document of the `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents` range is corrected on one of the types for which the line recalls the paper originals whenever an issued document is corrected. It also describes the agent tool that enters that fee.

## Reach of the charge

The charge covers post-issue corrections on those types. Each such correction is charged by exactly one correction fee entry, linked to the correction request it charges. Only corrections that the documentation party asks for in order to change what it supplied fall within it; a correction arising from the line's own keying error stays free of charge, and this charge enters nothing for it.

## What the fee prices

The fee is the price of a correction that has actually been made. A fee entry is correct only for a correction request whose particular reads, on the document, in the new wording or figure requested. If the particular on the document still shows the old wording, there is no executed correction for the entry to price, and an entry booked against that request would be charging for something that does not exist on the document.

## Invoking `charge_correction_fee_18211c73`

This tool belongs to the agent. To use it, the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then runs it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`. A run adds one correction-fee charge to the documentation account of the document, linked to the correction request it charges and dated on the day of the run, and raises the documentation charges due on the document by the amount booked.

### Parameters

| Argument | What it holds | Form |
|---|---|---|
| `bl_id` | The transport document on which the fee is entered, given by the reference the transport document lookup reports | Reference text |
| `booking_id` | The booking behind that document: the reference printed on the document record, which the booking lookup also yields | Reference text |
| `request_id` | The correction request this charge relates to, given by the reference the documentation service request lookup lists | Reference text |
| `amount_usd` | The fee booked | US dollars written with exactly two decimal places, such as 12.30, and no currency sign |

### Return

If the run succeeds, the reply is a single confirmation sentence. It gives the reference of the new documentation charge (opaque, beginning "bcf_"), the transport document reference, the correction request charged, the amount in USD with two decimals and the resulting documentation charges due. The appearance of the sentence is what signals success, after which the fee is visible in the documentation history and in the charges due.

## Basis Q&A

**Two particulars were corrected on the same document. How many fee entries arise?** One per correction request, and each particular has its own request.
